articles.title: All the key moments from the 2026 British Grand Prix
articles.summary: All the key moments from the 2026 British Grand Prix. Charles Leclerc enjoyed a long-awaited return to the top step of the podium at the British Grand Prix during an action-packed weekend both on and off track.

articles.title: 5 betting lessons learnt after Leclerc wins at Silverstone
articles.summary: 5 betting lessons learnt after Leclerc wins at Silverstone. Charles Leclerc won his first Grand Prix of the season as Drivers’ Championship leader Kimi Antonelli suffered another mechanical issue.

articles.title: What the teams said – Race day in Great Britain
articles.summary: What the teams said – Race day in Great Britain. The drivers and teams report back on all the action from Silverstone for the 2026 British Grand Prix.

articles.title: Rare Sainz penalty for Safety Car infringement confirmed
articles.summary: Rare Sainz penalty for Safety Car infringement confirmed. Carlos Sainz has been handed a post-race penalty following the British Grand Prix after a Safety Car infringement.

articles.title: 'A lot to improve' – McLaren drivers assess their British GP
articles.summary: 'A lot to improve' – McLaren drivers assess their British GP. Reigning World Champion Lando Norris believes McLaren "have a lot to improve" after a difficult British Grand Prix, which yielded fourth place.

articles.title: Verstappen details Red Bull issue behind his British GP crash
articles.summary: Verstappen details Red Bull issue behind his British GP crash. After crashing out at Silverstone, Max Verstappen has opened up on the recurring issue that forced him out of the British Grand Prix.

articles.title: British GP problems 'tough to swallow' for Antonelli
articles.summary: British GP problems 'tough to swallow' for Antonelli. Kimi Antonelli admits failing to score any points in the British Grand Prix was "tough to swallow", as the Mercedes driver was hit by late car problems when on course to challenge for victory.

articles.title: Verdict in Hamilton post-race investigation announced
articles.summary: Verdict in Hamilton post-race investigation announced. Following his podium at the British Grand Prix, Lewis Hamilton faced the stewards post-race after being investigated for a yellow flag infringement.

articles.title: Gladysz inherits Silverstone F3 Feature Race win
articles.summary: Gladysz inherits Silverstone F3 Feature Race win. ART Grand Prix rookie Maciej Gladysz finished fourth on the road but inherited victory after multiple penalties elsewhere.

articles.title: Russell 'brutally honest' on his British GP performance
articles.summary: Russell 'brutally honest' on his British GP performance. George Russell admits "I'm not going to fight for a championship if the performances continue like that", despite claiming his first podium in the British Grand Prix.

articles.title: Making sense of that frustrating and confusing British GP finish
articles.summary: Making sense of that frustrating and confusing British GP finish. There were a number of moments during the British Grand Prix that felt like the application of the regulations was unfair, but take a step back at the decisions taken post-race and it looks more like a case that the rules were applied...

articles.title: Quashing negativity makes British GP win especially sweet for Leclerc
articles.summary: Quashing negativity makes British GP win especially sweet for Leclerc. Charles Leclerc says his form this season has led to negativity and “narratives being created” that make his victory in the British Grand Prix even more impactful.

articles.title: FIA explains lack of race restart at end of British Grand Prix
articles.summary: FIA explains lack of race restart at end of British Grand Prix. The FIA says a software error made it appear that there would be a late race restart at the British Grand Prix, with protocol followed that saw the race end under a safety car.

articles.title: Hamilton escapes penalty over yellow flag infringement
articles.summary: Hamilton escapes penalty over yellow flag infringement. Lewis Hamilton has retained his third place in the British Grand Prix after escaping a time penalty for not slowing for a yellow flag.

articles.title: Leclerc puts Ferrari back on top with British GP victory
articles.summary: Leclerc puts Ferrari back on top with British GP victory. Charles Leclerc claimed victory at the British Grand Prix after an anti-climactic ending in which the safety car failed to return to pit lane one lap from the finish. Pole-getter and championship leader Kimi Antonelli finished outside the poi...

articles.title: Qualifying progress more important than P2 result for Leclerc
articles.summary: Qualifying progress more important than P2 result for Leclerc. Charles Leclerc says he is more encouraged by the progress he has made in regaining the feeling for his Ferrari's handling during qualifying than his actual front row grid position at the British Grand Prix.

articles.title: Russell puzzled by top speed deficit to Antonelli, McLarens
articles.summary: Russell puzzled by top speed deficit to Antonelli, McLarens. George Russell says he has been hampered by a straight-line speed deficit to other Mercedes-powered cars after qualifying fourth at the British Grand Prix.

articles.title: Antonelli holds off Ferraris for British GP pole
articles.summary: Antonelli holds off Ferraris for British GP pole. Title leader Kimi Antonelli claimed his fifth pole position of the season in a commanding qualifying performance at the British Grand Prix.

articles.title: Antonelli encouraged by Mercedes race pace in Sprint as Hamilton sees Ferrari power deficit looming larger
articles.summary: Antonelli encouraged by Mercedes race pace in Sprint as Hamilton sees Ferrari power deficit looming larger. The Sprint has left Kimi Antonelli positive ahead of the British Grand Prix, but Lewis Hamilton is wary of Ferrari's deficit.

articles.title: Antonelli beats Hamilton in Silverstone Sprint
articles.summary: Antonelli beats Hamilton in Silverstone Sprint. Kimi Antonelli prevailed in a duel with Lewis Hamilton to win the Sprint at Silverstone.

articles.title: Safety car decisive again in confusing end to chaotic race
articles.summary: Safety car decisive again in confusing end to chaotic race. The safety car staying out might have been an unsatisfactory way to end the British Grand Prix but this time the rules were followed, writes Andrew Benson.

articles.title: Red Bull wing failure 'super-dangerous' - Verstappen
articles.summary: Red Bull wing failure 'super-dangerous' - Verstappen. Max Verstappen says the rear wing failure on his Red Bull that caused him to crash at two consecutive grands prix was "super-dangerous".

articles.title: Strong weekend for Lindblad and Leclerc composed - driver ratings
articles.summary: Strong weekend for Lindblad and Leclerc composed - driver ratings. BBC Radio 5 Live F1 commentator Harry Benjamin rates how the drivers performed during the British Grand Prix.

articles.title: Leclerc wins dramatic race from Russell and Hamilton
articles.summary: Leclerc wins dramatic race from Russell and Hamilton. Charles Leclerc wins an incident-packed British Grand Prix from George Russell in which both Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen failed to score points.

articles.title: F1: Chequered Flag
articles.summary: F1: Chequered Flag. Damon Hill joins Rosanna and Harry live on stage to reflect on a dramatic race

articles.title: British Grand Prix breaks F1 attendance record
articles.summary: British Grand Prix breaks F1 attendance record. A record-breaking 564,000 fans attend across the four-day race event.

articles.title: Andrew Benson Q&A: Send us your questions
articles.summary: Andrew Benson Q&A: Send us your questions. Our F1 correspondent Andrew Benson is doing a weekly Q&A this season, so get your questions in now.

articles.title: Record crowd hoping for home win - but will Antonelli 'disappear into distance'?
articles.summary: Record crowd hoping for home win - but will Antonelli 'disappear into distance'?. Close to 180,000 people are expected to attend Sunday's British Grand Prix but auguries for a home win are not that good, writes Andrew Benson.

articles.title: Antonelli beats Leclerc & Hamilton to Silverstone pole
articles.summary: Antonelli beats Leclerc & Hamilton to Silverstone pole. Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli takes pole position for the British Grand Prix, beating the Ferraris and team-mate George Russell.

articles.title: Antonelli passes Hamilton to win Silverstone sprint
articles.summary: Antonelli passes Hamilton to win Silverstone sprint. Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli overtakes Lewis Hamilton to win an action-packed sprint race at the British Grand Prix.
